name: Lithuania

authorities.competent_authority: VVKT (Valstybinė vaistų kontrolės tarnyba prie Lietuvos Respublikos sveikatos apsaugos ministerijos, State Medicines Control Agency under the Ministry of Health): carries out the scientific assessment and issues the national authorisation.
authorities.ethics: Lithuanian Bioethics Committee (Lietuvos bioetikos komitetas): provides the ethical review conclusion used for the national decision; publishes the national Part II document list, recommendations and sample forms (approved 17 May 2022, amended 18 October 2022) and an FAQ. Its sample forms are recommended, not mandatory; an equivalent format is acceptable if it fully covers the required information.
authorities.fee: A fixed Lithuanian state fee applies to authorisation of a clinical trial and to a substantial modification; proof of payment is a mandatory item of the national list (LT-FEE, CTIS Forms section). Amount and payment route are not stated in the guides (DECISIONS.md, Missing).
authorities.national_guidance: Lithuanian Bioethics Committee Part II recommendations and sample forms (17 May 2022, amended 18 October 2022), ICF recommendations and FAQ; Law on Ethics of Biomedical Research; EudraLex Volume 10 including CTR Q&A version 7.3 (July 2026); Regulation (EU) No 536/2014.

answer_languages_note: One package language. Part II forms are answered in Lithuanian (matching the supplied Lithuanian variable sheet); every document in the national list is submitted in Lithuanian.

language_rules.rule: The Lithuanian Bioethics Committee states that the Part II documents covered by its national recommendations must be submitted in Lithuanian: recruitment and informed consent procedure, participant information, investigator suitability, declarations of interest, site suitability, insurance, financial arrangements, proof of payment, GDPR compliance and biological samples. English source documents may be used for global drafting, but the Lithuania package is built around the Lithuanian versions.
language_rules.non_lithuanian_speakers: If a person who does not understand Lithuanian may be consented, define the language and consent pathway in advance, give the information in a language the person understands, and describe the handling in K1. A witness does not compensate for a participant not understanding the language.
language_rules.form_answers: Shared EU forms (content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Lithuanian, matching the supplied Lithuanian variable sheet.
language_rules.third_party_documents: Insurer certificates, training certificates and other documents issued by others are also covered by the Lithuanian-language rule; see DECISIONS.md D2.

study_facts_country_specific.population.non_lithuanian_speakers: Will people who do not understand Lithuanian be consented? (language and consent pathway defined in advance; K1 v108)
study_facts_country_specific.compensation.reimbursement_or_payment_ap: Are participant costs reimbursed or is time compensated (including contraception costs)? (P1 trigger)
study_facts_country_specific.contraception.required_by_trial: Does the protocol require contraception specifically because of trial participation? (costs compensated; ICF and P1)
study_facts_country_specific.visits.home_visits: Are home visits planned? (exceptional; described in protocol, K1 and ICF)
study_facts_country_specific.data.race_or_ethnicity_collected: Are race or ethnicity data collected? (scientifically justified and explained in the ICF)

template.basis: EudraLex Volume 10 recruitment and informed-consent procedure template, version 2.0 (applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026); the procedure content is mandatory and the exact template form is highly recommended. The Lithuanian Bioethics Committee sample consent-procedure form (recommendations of 17 May 2022, amended 18 October 2022) is recommended, not mandatory; its content is carried in the national fields.

documents.content: How, when and where potential participants are approached, how privacy is protected, how much time they receive to decide, how understanding is checked and how withdrawal is handled. Every special consent pathway in the protocol (minors with the under-12 and 12-plus groups, limited-capacity adults, impartial witness, emergency enrolment) has its section completed with the Lithuanian additions; the procedure must match the actual consent forms.

national_fields.v105: Required in Lithuania: in Lithuanian, when advertisements or other recruitment material are used, give the explanation the Lithuanian Bioethics Committee expects: why advertising is needed, where each item will be placed, what happens to respondents found ineligible (including at the first visit), whether reimbursement is available to eligible and ineligible respondents, and how personal data collected from respondents are handled. For healthy volunteers, state how they are identified and screened, and how health data given before enrolment are collected, kept and handled for people found ineligible.
national_fields.v108: Required in Lithuania: in Lithuanian, state that the participant information and consent documents are provided in Lithuanian; that, where a person who does not understand Lithuanian may be consented, the language and consent pathway are defined in advance and the person receives the information in a language they understand; that the participant or legally designated representative and the investigator or authorised research person sign and date the consent record (with time and, where another person consents, the basis of representation) when consent is obtained, never on the blank CTIS version; that the participant receives a copy also signed by the investigator or authorised research person; whether electronic consent is used and, if so, that the legal validity of the electronic signature method is established (a simple electronic signature is not automatically equivalent to a handwritten one; prior agreement and durable-medium storage; separate rules for tablet signatures); and, where home visits are planned, that they are exceptional and described in the protocol and consent documents.
national_fields.v110: Required in Lithuania when incapacitated adults are included: in Lithuanian, state which categories of person entitled under Lithuanian law (Law on Ethics of Biomedical Research: spouse, specified close relatives, appointed representative, guardian of a person adjudged incapacitated in healthcare matters, curator together with the person where legal capacity is limited in healthcare matters) may consent and how the site verifies and documents the representative's authority and legal basis (not a generic label such as 'family member'); how capacity is assessed for the actual decision (age, serious illness or diagnosis alone do not establish incapacity) and who reassesses it; how the participant receives adapted information and is involved as far as possible; how dissent, including non-verbal objection where clinically relevant, is identified, recorded and respected; that only compensation for expenses and loss of earnings is offered; and who assesses regained capacity and which current ICF version is then used for the participant's own consent.
national_fields.v114: Required in Lithuania when minors are included: in Lithuanian, describe the two national age groups: for children under 12, how the child is informed orally in a way appropriate to age and maturity, whether written information is also provided, and that the information process and the child's opinion are documented in the trial records; for children aged 12 and above, that information is given orally and in writing and that the child signs an assent form when capable of understanding it. State that consent of both parents is normally required, with the defined exceptions (a parent deceased, incapacitated, declared dead or missing by a court, or with restricted parental rights; a notarised power of attorney for health-related decisions; a court grant of exclusive decision rights), that the reason for a single parental signature is documented, and that physical absence or inconvenience alone is not enough. State that a capable child's wish not to participate or to withdraw is respected even when the parents consent, except where non-participation or withdrawal would be contrary to the child's interests, when the representatives decide taking the investigator's opinion into account; and describe re-consent with the current approved adult ICF when the participant reaches the age of legal competence.
national_fields.v117: Required in Lithuania when an impartial witness may be needed: in Lithuanian, state why the witnessed pathway may be needed (participant or legally designated representative can decide but cannot write), which participants may use it, how the impartial witness is selected so that impartiality is preserved (not left to ad hoc site practice; no person whose interests could compromise the record), how the information is communicated, which alternative method records the participant's consent, that the witness and the person conducting the interview sign and date the consent document, and how the participant receives a copy. A witness does not replace a legally designated representative and does not compensate for a participant not understanding the language.
national_fields.v121: Required in Lithuania when emergency enrolment is used: in Lithuanian, explain why prior consent is impossible in the defined emergency, how the urgency is recognised, how the situation and eligibility for emergency enrolment are documented, how the investigator checks for a known prior objection, why a representative cannot be reached within the therapeutic window, what information is given as soon as possible after the intervention, who seeks consent to continue (without undue delay; for minors in line with the Lithuanian parent and child rules), and what happens if the participant or representative refuses later consent, including the right to object to the use of data already obtained.

documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, K skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas, pateikiamas lietuvių kalba; atsakymai šioje formoje rašomi lietuvių kalba. Tai procedūrinis užsakovo ar tyrimo centro dokumentas: pateikiant tiriamieji jo nepasirašo. Pagrindas: ES šablonas „Recruitment and informed consent procedure“ 2.0 versija (taikoma naujiems II dalies pateikimams nuo 2026 m. rugsėjo 1 d.); Lietuvos bioetikos komiteto pavyzdinė forma rekomenduojama, bet neprivaloma. Užpildykite valstybės narės laukus Lietuvai (žr. national_fields): reklamos pagrindimas, informuoto asmens sutikimo forma lietuvių kalba, parašai su data, laiku ir atstovavimo pagrindu, elektroninio parašo teisinis galiojimas, vizitai namuose. Kiekvienam ypatingam sutikimo būdui (nepilnamečiai iki 12 metų ir 12 metų bei vyresni, abiejų tėvų sutikimas, neveiksnūs suaugusieji, nešališkas liudytojas, skubios būklės atvejai) užpildykite atitinkamą skyrių; kitu atveju nurodykite, kad netaikoma. Tvarka turi atitikti faktines sutikimo formas.

documents.trigger_text: Advertisements, posters, flyers, email invitations, audio, video or similar recruitment materials will be used.
documents.content: Copies or recordings of each recruitment item in Lithuanian. The supporting explanation the Lithuanian Bioethics Committee expects (why advertising is needed, where it is placed, handling of ineligible respondents, reimbursement, respondents' personal data) is given in K1 (fields v102, v103 and v105), see DECISIONS.md D3.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, K skyrius. Sąlyginis: pateikiamas, jei naudojami skelbimai, plakatai, lankstinukai, kvietimai el. paštu, garso, vaizdo ar panaši medžiaga; vienas dokumentas kiekvienai priemonei. Lietuvių kalba; pateikiant nepasirašoma. Be šablono: rengiama pagal protokolą ir K1 tvarką. Pagrindimas, kurio tikisi Lietuvos bioetikos komitetas (kodėl reikia reklamos, kur ji bus skelbiama, kas bus daroma su netinkamais respondentais, išlaidų atlyginimas, respondentų asmens duomenų tvarkymas), pateikiamas K1 formoje.

documents.name_en: Participant information and Informed Consent Form, one set per population and decision-maker
documents.template_status: missing: no Lithuanian participant templates supplied; see population_sets (every template "missing") and DECISIONS.md D13.
documents.content: Blank Lithuanian participant information and Informed Consent Form for each population, used before the person decides. Covers trial purpose, procedures, risks and burdens, possible benefits, alternatives, withdrawal, insurance and compensation, confidentiality, data processing, samples where applicable, contacts and the consent statements the protocol needs. Signature blocks with names, signatures, date, time and the basis of representation where applicable, completed only when consent is obtained. See population_sets.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, L skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas lietuvių kalba, pateikiamas nepasirašytas. Tiriamasis arba teisėtas atstovas ir sutikimo pokalbį vedantis asmuo pasirašo ir nurodo datą bei laiką tik gaudami sutikimą; jei sutikimą duoda kitas asmuo, nurodomas atstovavimo pagrindas. Tiriamajam įteikiama kopija, kurią taip pat pasirašo tyrėjas arba įgaliotas tyrimo asmuo. Atskiri dokumentai kiekvienai populiacijai, kurios sutikimo logika skiriasi. Lietuviško šablono nėra: rengiama pagal Lietuvos gaires (drafting_rules) arba pritaikant atskaitos dokumentą.

documents.name_en: Other information given before the participation decision
documents.trigger_text: Other information that forms part of the pre-participation decision package and falls within the participant information required by Annex I (for example a subject card listed in the national Part II list).
documents.note: Current Lithuanian Bioethics Committee FAQ guidance recommends limiting additional patient-facing submissions to the documents required by the relevant Annex I sections unless another document is needed. Do not upload every operational patient-facing document; first decide whether it is part of recruitment, consent or information needed before the participation decision.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, L skyrius. Sąlyginis: tik kita informacija, kuri yra sprendimo dalyvauti paketo dalis ir patenka į I priedo reikalaujamą informaciją tiriamajam (pvz., tiriamojo kortelė). Pagal dabartinius Lietuvos bioetikos komiteto DUK papildomi tiriamiesiems skirti dokumentai ribojami I priedo reikalaujamais dokumentais. Lietuvių kalba; pateikiant nepasirašoma.

documents.ctis_section: N (proposed; the guide gives no CTIS location, DECISIONS.md D5)
documents.ctis_title: N2_List of trial sites and principal investigators_LT
documents.name_en: List of Lithuanian trial sites and principal investigators
documents.content: Each planned Lithuanian site with the principal investigator, the investigator's position and the expected number of participants. Must match the CTIS site data, M1, M2 and N1.
documents.filled_by: sponsor (site data); TrialAgents checks it against CTIS, M1, M2 and N1 (DECISIONS.md D6)
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis (vieta gairėse nenurodyta; siūloma N skyriuje). Privalomas dokumentas lietuvių kalba: planuojamų tyrimo centrų Lietuvoje sąrašas su kiekvieno centro pagrindiniu tyrėju, jo pareigomis ir numatomu tiriamųjų skaičiumi. Pateikiant nepasirašoma. Duomenis pateikia užsakovas; nieko neišgalvoti. Turi atitikti CTIS duomenis, M1, M2 ir N1.

documents.name_en: Description of investigator qualifications with sponsor compliance statement
documents.per_note: One document covering every Lithuanian investigator; split per site if the sponsor prefers (DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.content: Description of the investigators' qualifications and a sponsor statement that they comply with the Clinical Trials Regulation and Lithuanian requirements. Training evidence: all investigators complete ICH E6(R3) training (documented even for experienced investigators); investigators without medicinal-product clinical trial investigator experience in the previous five years need a GCP training certificate.
documents.filled_by: sponsor (statement) with investigator training evidence (DECISIONS.md D7)
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, M skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas lietuvių kalba: tyrėjų kvalifikacijos aprašymas ir užsakovo pareiškimas, kad ši kvalifikacija atitinka Reglamentą (ES) Nr. 536/2014 ir Lietuvos reikalavimus. Pagal dabartinius Lietuvos bioetikos komiteto DUK visi tyrėjai turi būti baigę ICH E6(R3) mokymus; tyrėjams, per pastaruosius penkerius metus neturėjusiems vaistinių preparatų klinikinių tyrimų tyrėjo patirties, reikia GCP mokymų pažymėjimo. Patyrusiems tyrėjams E6(R3) mokymai vis tiek dokumentuojami. Asmens duomenų neišgalvoti.

template.basis: EU CV template; the Lithuanian Bioethics Committee sample CV form is recommended, not mandatory

documents.content: Current curriculum vitae of each principal investigator. Personal details come from the investigator; the assistant fills only the trial fields.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, M skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas kiekvienam pagrindiniam tyrėjui ir centrui, lietuvių kalba (DECISIONS.md D2). Naudojama ES gyvenimo aprašymo forma; Lietuvos bioetikos komiteto pavyzdinė forma rekomenduojama, bet neprivaloma. Gyvenimo aprašymas turi būti dabartinis. Asmens duomenis pateikia tyrėjas: asistentas įrašo tik tyrimo pavadinimą ir ES tyrimo numerį, nieko neišgalvoja.

documents.signature_note: The Lithuanian national Part II list explicitly requires each declaration to be signed; the principal investigator signs and dates it before upload. The EU template has name, institution and date lines but no signature line (DECISIONS.md D8).
documents.content: Completed declaration of interest for each principal investigator, signed. Interests are declared by the investigator; the assistant fills only the trial title and EU trial number.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, M skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas kiekvienam pagrindiniam tyrėjui ir centrui, lietuvių kalba. Lietuvos nacionaliniame II dalies sąraše aiškiai reikalaujama, kad kiekviena interesų deklaracija būtų pasirašyta: tyrėjas ją pasirašo ir nurodo datą prieš įkeliant į CTIS. Interesus deklaruoja pats tyrėjas; asistentas įrašo tik tyrimo pavadinimą ir ES tyrimo numerį, parašo nepildo ir neimituoja.

template.basis: EU site-suitability template (CTAG), fulfils Annex I point 67; the Lithuanian Bioethics Committee sample form (with signature and date fields) is recommended, not mandatory

documents.signature_note: Issued, signed and dated by the head of the clinic or institution at the trial site, or that person's delegate, before CTIS submission.
documents.content: Written suitability statement for each Lithuanian site, specific to this protocol (facilities, equipment, procedures, human resources). Site-specific facts are confirmed by the site; the signature block stays empty for the head of institution.

national_fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Lithuania: the statement is issued by the head of the clinic or institution at the trial site, or by that person's delegate, and is signed and dated before CTIS submission. Leave name, position, signature and date empty for that person; never fill or simulate them.

documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields left empty for the site; signed by the head of institution or delegate
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, N skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas kiekvienam tyrimo centrui, lietuvių kalba; atsakymai rašomi lietuvių kalba. Pažymą išduoda tyrimo centro klinikos ar įstaigos vadovas arba jo įgaliotas asmuo; ji pasirašoma ir nurodoma data prieš pateikiant CTIS. Asistentas parašo, vardo, pareigų ir datos laukų nepildo. Centro duomenys (pavadinimas, pagrindinis tyrėjas, tiriamųjų skaičius) paliekami centrui. Lietuvos bioetikos komiteto pavyzdinė forma rekomenduojama, bet neprivaloma; ES forma tinka, jei apima visą reikalaujamą informaciją (I priedo 67 punktas).

documents.ctis_title_alternative: O2_Proof of coverage_<sponsor or site> (when other proof of indemnification is submitted instead of an insurance certificate)
documents.name_en: Civil liability insurance certificate or policy, or other proof of indemnification
documents.content: Certificate or policy, or other proof of indemnification, demonstrating the applicable cover. Check before upload that it corresponds to the Lithuanian trial, the sponsor, the investigators and the covered activities. Participant documents must describe the insurance or indemnification arrangements and how to seek compensation consistently with it.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, O skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas: civilinės atsakomybės draudimo liudijimas arba polisas, arba kitas žalos atlyginimo užtikrinimo įrodymas. Prieš įkeliant patikrinti, ar jis atitinka Lietuvoje atliekamą tyrimą, užsakovą, tyrėjus ir draudžiamą veiklą. Išduoda draudikas; kalba – lietuvių (DECISIONS.md D2).

documents.name_en: Reimbursement of participant costs and compensation for time
documents.trigger_text: Participant costs are reimbursed or participants are compensated for time spent in the research (including compensation of contraception costs when contraception is required specifically because of the trial).
documents.content: Description of reimbursement of participant costs and any compensation for time. Lithuania regulates compensation for time spent in biomedical research; the ICF states an approximate hourly amount when time is compensated. Amounts and conditions identical to every participant document and to the financing information (LT-P2).
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, P skyrius. Privalomas, kai atlyginamos tiriamųjų išlaidos arba mokama kompensacija už laiką (DECISIONS.md D9). Atsakymai lietuvių kalba; nepasirašoma. Lietuvoje kompensacija už biomedicininiame tyrime praleistą laiką reglamentuojama: jei ji mokama, informuoto asmens sutikimo formoje nurodoma apytikslė valandinė suma. Kai kontracepcija būtina būtent dėl dalyvavimo tyrime, jos išlaidos kompensuojamos. Neveiksniems suaugusiesiems ir nepilnamečiams – tik išlaidų ir negautų pajamų kompensacija. Sumos ir sąlygos turi sutapti su informacija tiriamajam ir finansavimo dokumentu (P2).

documents.content: Trial financing, financial transactions, compensation paid to participants and to the investigator or site, and other relevant financial agreements with the site. Consistent with P1 and the ICF.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, P skyrius. Privalomas dokumentas lietuvių kalba: tyrimo finansavimas, finansiniai sandoriai, tiriamiesiems ir tyrėjui ar centrui mokamos kompensacijos bei kiti susiję finansiniai susitarimai su centru. Informaciją pateikia užsakovas; ji turi atitikti P1 ir informuoto asmens sutikimo formą.

documents.ctis_section: Forms (proof of payment; not a Part II section per the naming guide)
documents.name_en: Proof of payment of the Lithuanian state fee
documents.content: Proof that the applicable fixed Lithuanian state fee has been paid. The fee applies to authorisation of a clinical trial and to a substantial modification. Amount and payment route are not stated in the guides.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS formų skiltis (mokėjimo įrodymas). Privalomas: įrodymas, kad sumokėta nustatyto dydžio valstybės rinkliava (taikoma klinikinio tyrimo leidimui ir esminiam pakeitimui). Sumos ir mokėjimo būdo gairės nenurodo. Pateikia užsakovas.

documents.ctis_section: R (or the CTIS Forms section, DECISIONS.md D10)
documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_LT

template.basis: EudraLex GDPR compliance statement; no Lithuanian national sentence required

documents.content: Sponsor statement that trial data will be collected and processed in accordance with the GDPR. It does not replace the participant-facing privacy information in the ICF, which must be consistent with it.

national_fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Not applicable in Lithuania: the guides require no national data-protection sentence in the GDPR statement. Remove.

documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, R skyrius (arba CTIS formų skiltis, DECISIONS.md D10). Privalomas užsakovo pareiškimas, kad tyrimo duomenys bus renkami ir tvarkomi pagal Bendrąjį duomenų apsaugos reglamentą. Lietuvių kalba. Nacionalinio duomenų apsaugos sakinio nereikia (pašalinti). Pareiškimas nepakeičia informacijos tiriamajam apie privatumą; ji turi atitikti šį pareiškimą ir faktinius duomenų srautus. Vardas, pavardė ir pareigos – tik iš užsakovo pateiktų duomenų.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_LT
documents.trigger_text: The trial involves collection, storage or future use of biological samples.

template.basis: EudraLex biological-samples form; the Lithuanian Bioethics Committee sample biological-sample form is recommended, not mandatory (DECISIONS.md D11)

documents.content: Information showing compliance with Lithuanian rules for collection, storage and future use of biological samples. Sample types, storage locations, retention period, future-use purpose, transfer arrangements and destruction or withdrawal process must agree with the participant information and any future-use consent.
documents.drafting_notes_lt: CTIS II dalis, S skyrius. Sąlyginis: pateikiamas, jei tyrime renkami, saugomi ar ateityje naudojami biologiniai mėginiai. Atsakymai lietuvių kalba; nepasirašoma. Mėginių tipai, saugojimo vietos, saugojimo trukmė, naudojimo ateityje tikslas, perdavimas ir sunaikinimo ar atsisakymo tvarka turi sutapti su informacija tiriamajam ir atskiru (pasirenkamu) sutikimu dėl naudojimo ateityje. Naudojimas ateityje už protokolo ribų yra pasirenkamas ir neturi būti dalyvavimo pagrindiniame tyrime sąlyga.

checklist_mapping_note: One document per item of the Lithuania Part II document checklist page (checklist_item 1-15). The page's signature section and the EU recruitment-template note are in signature_at_submission, the K1 template basis and checklists/part-ii-package.json.

fields.v117: Required in Lithuania when an impartial witness may be needed: in Lithuanian, state why the witnessed pathway may be needed (participant or legally designated representative can decide but cannot write), which participants may use it, how the impartial witness is selected so that impartiality is preserved (not left to ad hoc site practice; no person whose interests could compromise the record), how the information is communicated, which alternative method records the participant's consent, that the witness and the person conducting the interview sign and date the consent document, and how the participant receives a copy. A witness does not replace a legally designated representative and does not compensate for a participant not understanding the language.
fields.v121: Required in Lithuania when emergency enrolment is used: in Lithuanian, explain why prior consent is impossible in the defined emergency, how the urgency is recognised, how the situation and eligibility for emergency enrolment are documented, how the investigator checks for a known prior objection, why a representative cannot be reached within the therapeutic window, what information is given as soon as possible after the intervention, who seeks consent to continue (without undue delay; for minors in line with the Lithuanian parent and child rules), and what happens if the participant or representative refuses later consent, including the right to object to the use of data already obtained.

fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Lithuania: the statement is issued by the head of the clinic or institution at the trial site, or by that person's delegate, and is signed and dated before CTIS submission. Leave name, position, signature and date empty for that person; never fill or simulate them.

fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Not applicable in Lithuania: the guides require no national data-protection sentence in the GDPR statement. Remove.

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section, for one population. No Lithuanian participant template was supplied: drafted from the Lithuania guides with styles/base.md, or adapted from a reference document.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field, including signatures, empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor, site, payment confirmation). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates_missing_handling: Draft each participant document from the Lithuania guides (drafting_rules, population_sets notes, checklists/participant-documents.json) with styles/base.md and styling.md, or adapt it from its reference-package counterpart (based_on), until a Lithuanian set is supplied and split into templates/participant (DECISIONS.md D13).

population_sets.basis: Lithuania patient information and consent guide; Lithuanian Bioethics Committee ICF recommendations (recommended, not mandatory); no Lithuanian template supplied.
population_sets.note: Standard Lithuanian participant information and ICF; also the current approved adult form for re-consent at the age of legal competence and after regained capacity.

For people who do not have the disease or condition under investigation. Not a renamed patient ICF: benefit, risk, alternatives, reimbursement and screening explanations changed. No direct medical benefit; incidental findings and referral; reimbursement versus compensation for time (approximate hourly amount), payment schedule, payment after screen failure or withdrawal; free IMP and trial health checks; screen-failure data handling. No separate national healthy-volunteer form exists.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_assent 12 and above_<population>_LT_lt
documents.condition: when participants aged 12 or above are included

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_child information under 12_<population>_LT_lt
documents.condition: only when written child information is appropriate to the population (DECISIONS.md D12)

population_sets.note: Parent or legal-representative information and consent with signature blocks for both parents (the normal pathway) and a documented exception; written adolescent information and assent form from age 12 (signed when the child can understand); under 12 oral information appropriate to age and maturity, with written information when appropriate and the child's opinion documented in the trial records. Do not use an adult ICF with a parent signature line added. Re-consent with the current approved adult form (LT-PT-main or LT-PT-healthy) at the age of legal competence.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_participant information_<population>_LT_lt
documents.condition: where the participant can engage with the decision

population_sets.note: Article 31 conditions. Consent by the person entitled under Lithuanian law (Law on Ethics of Biomedical Research), with the legal basis recorded on the form. Adapted participant information so that the participant takes part as far as possible; dissent respected; only compensation for expenses and loss of earnings; participant's own consent with LT-PT-main when capacity is regained.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency legal representative_<population>_LT_lt
documents.condition: where the population may remain incapable and representative consent is required

population_sets.note: Article 35 pathway only when every condition is met. Post-intervention ICF for the participant once capable, and a legally designated representative version where needed; both explain what has already happened, what continued participation involves, the right to refuse, and the right to object to use of data already obtained. For minors the later consent follows the Lithuanian parent and child rules (minors set). No national emergency ICF template exists.

Only for a participant or legally designated representative who can decide but cannot write. Same substantive information as the main ICF; alternative consent method recorded; witness and interviewer signature and date fields; copy to the participant. Not for lack of capacity and not for language barriers. No separate national witness form exists (DECISIONS.md D14).

Only when follow-up involves data collection or medical-record access not adequately covered by the approved main ICF. Limited to the actual follow-up: categories, period, maternal records, outcome and infant data, recipients, coding, transfers, retention, refusal and withdrawal.

Separate information and consent addressed to the pregnant partner before identifiable information is collected from her or her medical records are accessed; the enrolled participant cannot consent for the partner. Infant data and follow-up duration stated.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_future use_LT_lt
documents.condition: separate future-use ICF; alternatively a distinct opt-in choice in the main ICF (DECISIONS.md D15)

population_sets.note: Lithuanian Bioethics Committee: a separate future-use ICF or a distinct, not pre-selected opt-in choice preceded by enough information. Covers purposes, storage duration and location, personal data issues and, as relevant, coding, access, recipients, transfers, commercial research, genetic analysis, return of results and withdrawal. Refusal does not affect main-trial participation. Applies to coded data as well as samples.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which documents a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents. Every template is "missing": none was supplied.

population_rules.authority: Lithuanian Bioethics Committee (recommendations on the list of Part II documents and sample forms, approved 17 May 2022 and amended 18 October 2022; recommendations for the Informed Consent Form; current FAQ) and VVKT; Republic of Lithuania Law on Ethics of Biomedical Research; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35; as recorded in the Lithuania guides reviewed 23 September 2026.
population_rules.template_status: missing: no Lithuanian participant templates were supplied. Every template id below is a planned id listed in participant_templates_missing, with no file ("template": "missing" in population_sets).

age_bands.rule: Oral information appropriate to age and maturity (mandatory); state whether written information is also provided; written child information only when developmentally appropriate (not a universal mandatory written format); the information process and the child's opinion are documented in the trial records; no assent signature required by the national rule.

age_bands.band: 12 and above (up to the age of legal competence)
age_bands.rule: Information orally and in writing (mandatory); the child signs an assent form when capable of understanding (conditional); language suited to age and maturity, not the adult ICF.

minors.age_band_basis: Lithuanian national Part II recommendations distinguish children under 12 from those aged 12 and above. The guides do not state the age of legal competence as a number (DECISIONS.md D12).
minors.representatives: Consent from both parents is normally required. Exceptions: one parent deceased, incapacitated, declared dead or missing by a court, or with restricted parental rights; a notarised power of attorney authorising one parent to represent the other in health-related decisions; a court grant of the exclusive right to one parent. The site documents why only one parent signs; physical absence or inconvenience alone does not remove the second-parent requirement.
minors.assent_dissent: Assent is not phrased as the child's legal consent. A child capable of understanding may refuse or withdraw, and the wish is respected even when the parents consent, except where non-participation or withdrawal would be contrary to the child's interests; then the representatives decide, taking the investigator's opinion into account. Documents and site process explain how dissent is recognised, documented and escalated.
minors.reconsent_at_legal_competence: LT-PT-main or LT-PT-healthy (the current approved adult ICF, not the historic version) before continued participation.
minors.payment: No incentives beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation (Article 32 CTR, as for incapacitated adults).

adults_without_capacity.note: Only when the person's health state prevents a reasonable assessment of their interests (or a formal legal status gives another person a role in consent); not because of age, serious illness or a diagnosis alone. The entitled person under the Law on Ethics of Biomedical Research (spouse, specified close relatives, appointed representative, guardian, curator together with the person) depends on the participant's factual and legal status; the legal basis is recorded. Adapted information where the participant can engage; dissent respected; re-consent with LT-PT-main when capacity is regained.

emergency.note: Representative version where the population may remain incapable. For minors use the minors rules (LT-PT-parents and the age-band documents) for later consent. No national emergency ICF template; do not invent a waiver form.

impartial_witness.note: Inability to write, not lack of capacity or language. A representative who cannot write also uses this pathway (witness block in the representative document).

pregnancy.participant: LT-PT-pregnancy only when follow-up involves data or record access not covered by the main ICF
pregnancy.partner: LT-PT-pregnant-partner whenever partner or infant data are collected from the partner or her records

secondary_use.note: Or a distinct opt-in choice in the main ICF (DECISIONS.md D15). Parent or representative versions when minors or incapacitated adults are included.

separate_document_rules: Use a separate or adapted document set whenever a population has different consent logic (Lithuania patient information and consent guide).
Minors: parent consent document plus age-appropriate child information and assent; never an adult ICF with a parent signature line added.
Healthy volunteers: a healthy-volunteer version, not a renamed patient ICF.
Future use of samples or coded data: a separate future-use ICF or a distinct opt-in choice; refusal does not affect main-trial participation (Lithuanian Bioethics Committee).
A pregnant partner receives a separate document addressed to her; the enrolled participant cannot consent on her behalf; participant and partner pathways are not mixed.
Emergency enrolment: later participant and representative documents describe the emergency situation; standard withdrawal text is not reused if it does not fit.
Re-consent at the age of legal competence or after regained capacity uses the current approved adult ICF.

drafting_rules: Participant documents are in Lithuanian, written understandably, avoiding specialist terminology where possible; translate the meaning of the approved master content, not word for word; medical terms understandable to the target population; consistent terms throughout.
Build each document from the actual protocol and submitted Part II information; generic consent language is not enough if it does not match what will happen at Lithuanian sites.
Make clear that this is research; do not imply that the investigational treatment is proven to help; possible benefits without overstating; alternatives where relevant.

Core content: sponsor and conductor, purpose, why the person is invited, design (randomisation, placebo), procedures, visits, tests and treatments, duration and follow-up, foreseeable risks, burdens and inconveniences, pregnancy and contraception precautions, samples, confidentiality and data processing, reimbursement, compensation and insurance, right to refuse or withdraw, what happens to data already collected after withdrawal, contacts for the trial, participant rights and research-related injury.

Short sections, plain explanations; separate what is required for the main trial from optional choices; the reader can tell which procedures are research-specific, what is optional and what happens if they say no.
State that the investigational medicinal product and trial health checks are free of charge where that is the case (Lithuanian Bioethics Committee recommendation).

Reimbursement of travel and other costs and any compensation for time explained; an approximate hourly amount stated when time is compensated; contraception costs compensated when contraception is required specifically because of the trial; amounts identical to P1 and P2.
Insurance or indemnification arrangements and how to seek compensation for trial-related harm, consistent with the submitted certificate or policy.

Privacy in participant language: confidentiality, the data controller where relevant, data sources and categories, who may access identifiable or coded data, recipients, storage and the participant's rights; consistent with the GDPR statement and actual data flows; trial consent is not a catch-all permission for every future data use. Race or ethnicity data only when scientifically justified, and the justification explained.
Samples: why collected, analyses for the main trial, where sent or stored and how long retained; future use beyond the main trial is a separate, optional, not pre-selected choice.
Home visits are exceptional and are described in the protocol and consent documents, especially where optional.
Electronic consent only with an electronic signature method whose legal validity is established; a simple electronic signature is not automatically equivalent to a handwritten one.

Signature blocks: participant or consent-giver and the investigator or authorised research person, with names, signatures, date and time, and the basis of representation where another person consents; the participant's copy is also signed by the investigator or authorised research person; witness blocks only where the pathway may be used; blank and unsigned in CTIS.
Filenames and document titles distinguish population and use case; ICF version number and date match the document register.

Participant templates were not supplied; where a reference document or a later template is used, its instructions ([square-bracket] notes, italic notes, '...........' gaps) and the Part II form instructions (yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: ...] labels) are drafting instructions; none may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.lithuania_note: Use the CTCG pattern. The Lithuania guides use descriptive names and give no national naming instruction beyond titles and filenames that distinguish population and use case. _LT_lt on participant-facing documents, _LT on O1, P1, P2, R1, S1 and national documents. The site list (N2), the investigator qualification statement (M3), the financing document (P2) and the proof of payment carry proposed titles to confirm (DECISIONS.md D5, D7, D9, D16).

sources_note: All Lithuania guides reviewed 23 September 2026, read 27 November 2026 (11 pages). '#n' after LT-PII-CHECKLIST is the item number on that page; '#signatures' and '#eu-recruitment-template' are its sections on submission signatures and the EU recruitment template; '#n' after LT-QC is the section number. Supplied: CTIS_LT Part II DOCX set and Lithuanian variable sheet (compared with the shared forms); no Lithuanian participant templates.
